concepts.name: Democracy and Rule of Law (Unit 8)
concepts.name_amharic: ዲሞክራሲ (Democracy) እና የሕግ የበላይነት (Rule of Law) (ምዕራፍ 8)
concepts.simple_definition: Democracy and Rule of Law is a core topic in Grade 9 Civics covering essential principles on pages 158-173.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ዲሞክራሲ (Democracy) እና የሕግ የበላይነት (Rule of Law) በ9ኛ ክፍል ሥነ-ዜጋ (Civics) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 158-173 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation: Comprehensive academic analysis of Democracy and Rule of Law. Students study how this principle operates within the Ethiopian Grade 9 curriculum on page 158-173.
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: የዲሞክራሲ (Democracy) እና የሕግ የበላይነት (Rule of Law) ጥልቅ ሳይንሳዊ ማብራሪያ፡ ተማሪዎች የዚህን ትምህርት መሠረታዊ ሕግጋትና አሰራር በ9ኛ ክፍል ሥነ-ዜጋ (Civics) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 158-173 ላይ በዝርዝር ይማራሉ።
concepts.real_example: Practical academic or real-world application of Democracy and Rule of Law.
concepts.real_example_amharic: በዲሞክራሲ (Democracy) እና የሕግ የበላይነት (Rule of Law) ትምህርት ውስጥ የሚታይ ተግባራዊና ሳይንሳዊ ምሳሌ።
concepts.common_confusion: Common academic confusion to avoid regarding Democracy and Rule of Law.
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: በዲሞክራሲ (Democracy) እና የሕግ የበላይነት (Rule of Law) ትምህርት ላይ ተማሪዎች ሊያጋጥማቸው የሚችለውን የተሳሳተ ግንዛቤ ማስወገድ።
